reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited Article 14.1 text supports it: the Term runs to the earlier of termination under 14.2 or payment of the last Approval Payment, with no automatic renewal, evergreen extension, non-renewal notice window or renewal price uplift.

With no auto-renewal mechanic, there is nothing operating against us; any continuation would require mutual written agreement, which aligns with the RENEWAL preferred position, so no redline or comment is correctly proposed.

The failed deterministic check ('non-renewal notice window ≤ 60 days — number not found') is expected and non-probative here, since the absence of any notice window is precisely the basis for compliance rather than a phrasing miss.
Redline is unchanged from the original paragraph and no comment was added, consistent with a compliant (internal evidence only) finding.
